one_liner: Ranks every number by the count over the last 104 draws (about two years), pulled towards the fair rate by a prior worth 52 fair draws.
registry_status_reason: Revision 1 installed for review and not yet released (E2R-R58): IN_DEVELOPMENT.txt is present and no SUPPORTED entry exists.
short_explanation: E_7 looks at each number on its own. It counts how often each number was drawn in the last 104 draws (about two years), then pulls that rate towards the fair-draw rate as if 52 perfectly fair draws had been added, so a short lucky run counts for less. It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its values are model-based chances of each number being drawn, not tested for calibration. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 104 earlier draws. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
